project_name: Telegram Digital Product Bot Admin Dashboard

context_strategy.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE CONTROL CENTER (Tactical & Precision Admin)
context_strategy.vibe: High-density command center for digital product automated sales via Telegram, managing crypto/bank deposits, inventory, exchange rates, and user privileges.
context_strategy.theme_mode: Dark-first with sleek high-contrast toggle support (Obsidian Slate primary base)
context_strategy.target_audience: Bot Admins / Operations Managers running Telegram digital store

font_pairings.heading_font: Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans (Clean, Modern, Tactical)
font_pairings.body_font: Inter / IBM Plex Sans (Highly legible for tables and numeric data)
font_pairings.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro (For wallet addresses, TX hashes, order IDs, exchange rates)

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Fixed left navigation sidebar on desktop (260px wide) with dark glass background, active section indicator, collapse mode on mobile
layout_and_spacing.header: Top sticky bar with z-40, title, quick metrics/status, exchange rate quick-toggle badge, dark backdrop blur (bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md) - NEVER transparent
layout_and_spacing.main_container: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden
layout_and_spacing.table_style: w-full text-left text-sm border-collapse bg-slate-900/60 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-slate-800

login_screen.description: Admin login modal/card centered with high security vibe, background subtle grid overlay, test credentials quick-fill trigger for demo ease

overview_dashboard.title: Ringkasan Utam (Overview)
components: 4 Main Stat Cards: Total Deposit (USD/IDR), Total Penjualan Produk, Saldo Beredar (Circulating Balance), Pending Deposit Count
Recent Deposits List with quick actions (Setujui / Tolak)
Sales Activity Chart (Recharts / Shadcn Chart) showing weekly deposit vs sales trend
System Status Widget (Exchange rate USD/IDR status, Active payment channels)

product_management.title: Kelola Produk Digital
features: Table of products with columns: Image/Icon, Nama Produk, Kategori, Harga USD, Harga IDR, Tipe Pengiriman (File/Link/Kode Lisensi), Status Aktif Toggle, Aksi (Edit/Hapus)
Create/Edit Product Dialog with File upload support for digital files, auto IDR calculator based on active exchange rate
Active status toggle directly in table with instant feedback toast

deposit_management.title: Kelola Deposit Saldo
features: Status Filter Tabs (Semua, Pending, Disetujui, Ditolak)
Table columns: ID Transaksi, User Telegram, Metode (Crypto Network/Bank), Jumlah (USD & IDR), Bukti Transfer / TX Hash, Status, Tanggal, Aksi
Bukti Transfer Preview Dialog (Image modal for bank proof or direct link for Tx Hash block explorer)
Approve/Reject modal with optional note input

user_management.title: Kelola Pengguna Telegram
features: Table of users: Telegram ID, Username, Saldo USD, Saldo IDR, Total Order, Status (Aktif/Dibekukan), Tanggal Bergabung, Aksi
Adjust Balance Modal (Tambah/Kurang saldo manual dengan alasan)
Freeze / Ban User Modal with reason input + Unban trigger

payment_settings.title: Pengaturan Pembayaran & Kurs
features: 8 Crypto Wallet Slots (USDT / USDC on Solana, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche) with deposit address input & QR preview
Bank Detail Config for IDR deposits (Bank Name, Account Number, Account Owner)
Exchange Rate Mode Switcher (Otomatis API / Manual Input) with live USD-IDR rate box
Minimum Deposit thresholds & Admin Telegram ID field

testing_and_accessibility.mandatory_data_testid_rule: Every button, input, tab, table row action, modal confirmation, and stat card value MUST include data-testid with kebab-case identifier.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Modals and dialogs must support Escape key closing and focus trap.
testing_and_accessibility.notifications: Use Sonner toast notifications (located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or custom setup) for action confirmations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React JS (all files are .jsx / .js) and Tailwind CSS with Shadcn UI primitives located in src/components/ui/
Ensure UI is strictly in Indonesian (ID) language as requested by problem statement
Provide interactive mock data persistence in React state or localStorage so demo flow (approving deposits, adjusting balances, creating products) works seamlessly
Keep navigation clean with a persistent Sidebar and sticky glass Header (never transparent background)
Always attach data-testid attributes to all interactive elements according to test_ids specification
Implement Sonner toast alerts for key actions (Product updated, Deposit approved, User banned, Settings saved)
